title: Agent blob store: unreferenced-blob quota, oldest-first eviction, one-hour floor
description:
Bead mimid-1wgh.14.4. RFC 8620 §6, for the agent's local endpoint (mimid-agent-jmap BlobStore, plaintext files under <state_dir>/blobs, content-addressed):
- "The server SHOULD use a separate quota for unreferenced blobs"; "This quota SHOULD be at least the maximum total size that a single object can reference".
- "When an upload would take the user over quota, the server MUST delete unreferenced blobs in date order, oldest first, until there is room for the new blob."
- "Except where quota restrictions force early deletion, an unreferenced blob MUST NOT be deleted for at least 1 hour from the time of upload; if reuploaded, the same blobId MAY be returned, but this SHOULD reset the expiry time."
- "A blob MUST NOT be deleted during the method call that removed the last reference".

1. Referenced: readings (a) only Message.attachments[].blobId; (b) any property named blobId or ending in BlobId (attachments, thumbnailBlobId, Chat avatarBlobId, editHistory revisions) of any stored object (Chat, ChatBan, ChatContact, Message, ReadPosition). Chosen (b): over-counting references only keeps a blob longer, never loses one. Pending attachment retries (retry.rs) hold an ExternalPart URL, not a local blob, so they reference nothing here; a blob a retry writes is named by its Message in the same sync, and the one-hour floor covers the gap. A destroyed Message is no longer stored and a retracted one has attachments [] (edits.rs), so their blobs become unreferenced.
2. Early deletion: readings (a) RFC 8620 §6 as written: under quota pressure delete oldest first even inside the hour; (b) never delete a blob younger than an hour: if evicting every older unreferenced blob still leaves no room, refuse the upload (403 overQuota, as mimid-server does) and delete nothing. Chosen (b): a client uploads its attachments and then creates the Message that names them; under (a) a second upload in that window would delete the first and the create would fail with invalidProperties. It departs from the MUST only when the quota is full of blobs under an hour old, where (a) breaks the client and (b) tells it.
3. Age: the file's mtime, set to the upload time when written and reset when the same content is uploaded again (the SHOULD), when a received attachment of the same content is stored, and when a Message/set create reads it to send, so a blob cannot be evicted between the send and the Message being stored (the last bullet).
4. Values: MAX_UNREFERENCED_BLOB_BYTES = 256 MiB (twice MAX_ATTACHMENTS_PER_MESSAGE x MAX_ATTACHMENT_LEN = 128 MiB, so the SHOULD on one object holds) and MAX_UNREFERENCED_BLOBS = 256 (INVENTED VALUES, NOT FROM SPEC), settable as blob_quota_bytes and blob_quota_count in the agent config and Options::with_blob_quota. Referenced blobs have no quota: they are bounded by what the user keeps. Eviction happens only on upload; there is no background sweep (RFC 8620 makes deletion of an unreferenced blob a MAY).
close_reason: Chosen by agent 2026-11-19 for mimid-1wgh.14.4: reference scan of any *blobId property; never evict under an hour (refuse overQuota instead, stricter than RFC 8620 §6); 256 MiB / 256 blobs (INVENTED). For Mark to judge.
